states.name: q
states.meaning: 3-bit modulo-7 counter state; synchronous load to 4 when a is high, otherwise increments by 1 modulo 7 when a is low

reset.name: a
reset.first_released_cycle: 45ns mid-cycle (a=0 carried; first sampled low at 55ns posedge)

mid: Optional mid-cycle input changes occur after the sampled edge and are carried to the next sampled edge; examples use no mid changes.

uncertain.note: Waveform-only inference: a=1 always shows q=4, but the role as synchronous reset/load versus an external load value is not uniquely determined.
candidates: synchronous load of constant 4 when a=1
hold q at 4 when a=1 after an initial condition

uncertain.note: Increment and modulo-7 wrap are inferred from the observed sequence 4,5,6,0,1; unobserved values 2,3 and illegal state 7 are not directly exercised.
candidates: modulo-7 up counter enabled when a=0
increment by one and wrap 6 to 0 when a=0
